metadata.label: State capital outlay and subsequent real growth
metadata.methodology: Actual state capital outlay is scaled by current-price GSDP and paired with next-year constant-price GSDP growth. The registered estimate uses state and fiscal-year fixed effects with state-clustered standard errors.
metadata.note: This is a state-year associational evaluation. It deliberately does not claim project-level or causal identification.

panel_estimate.interpretation: Within-state change in next-year real GSDP growth associated with a one percentage-point change in capital outlay/GSDP after removing common year effects.
panel_estimate.limitation: State and year fixed effects do not remove time-varying policy choices, disasters, transfers, project selection or reverse causality; this is not a causal multiplier.

median_state_capex_pct_gsdp.label: Median state capital outlay/GSDP
median_state_capex_pct_gsdp.methodology: Cross-state median of capital outlay divided by current-price GSDP.
median_state_capex_pct_gsdp.source_note: State accounting coverage and budget status vary; only observations labelled actual are used in the panel estimate.

median_next_year_real_gsdp_growth.label: Median next-year real GSDP growth
median_next_year_real_gsdp_growth.methodology: Cross-state median of the subsequent fiscal year's constant-price GSDP growth.
median_next_year_real_gsdp_growth.source_note: Growth is an outcome association, not a project-level return.
